# Release Candidate evidence context

This named Generated Solution records one immutable `1.0.0-rc.1` candidate
from a clean reviewed commit. It is an acceptance seam for release evidence,
not a template source to reapply over application-owned code.

The evidence manifest covers exact artifact identities, complete gate outcomes,
compatibility, reproducibility, licensing and provenance, real-provider and
failure-injection results, security, performance, deployment, documentation,
and Agent Readiness.
